_about.purpose: Primary seeding path for the per-project denylist. Everything here is known before the PDF is opened — it is in the contract, the title block, and the PM system — so filling this in is both faster and more accurate than scraping candidates back out of the document.
_about.usage: Copy to project-metadata.local.json, fill in, then run with --project-metadata config/project-metadata.local.json. Values are merged with --denylist when both are supplied.
_about.handling: Contains project-identifying information. Save with mode 0600 and treat as NDA-protected source material. *.local.json is git-ignored.
_about.guidance: List every spelling variant that appears in the documents: full legal name, common short form, all-caps title-block form, and any abbreviation. The matcher is exact (whitespace-tolerant, case-insensitive) — it will not guess.

project_name: Martin Luther King Jr. Recreation Center
